text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Etobicoke York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner of 34 Renown Road to maintain an existing 1.82m cedar hedge in the front yard of the property with the intent of allowing it to mature to 2.44 m. The fence will exceed the permitted height of 1.2m for a front yard fence. The fence does not meet all of the requirements specified in City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447, Fences.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Granted the application for a fence exemption by the applicant of 34 Renown Road, with a condition that the 5 trees in the front yard hedge which are closest to the road are removed, thereby allowing 5 remaining trees in the front yard hedge to be maintained and permitted to grow to 2.44 metres, as requested. Directed and require that the front yard hedge be maintained in good repair without alteration. Directed and require that at such time as replacement of the front yard hedge is required, the installations will comply fully with Municipal Code Chapter 447, or its successor by-law.
